claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The crew's return follows a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will plunge into the atmosphere just before the scheduled splashdown.
Live coverage is available on NASA TV.
Live coverage is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
The crew will be recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will undergo a "skip entry" technique to re-enter Earth's atmosphere.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will re-enter Earth's atmosphere at over 23,000 mph.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will deploy parachutes to slow to about 17 mph for landing.
